description: Why a stock moved on a day, in one call: its return against the market and how rare it was for this stock (a market model fitted on the year before, with a z-score), the company's SEC filings around the day (8-K items named), and the press's headlines from those days.

benchmark.description: The market to compare with; default SPY.

date.description: The trading day of the move (YYYY-MM-DD).

news.description: Add the press's headlines (GDELT, about five seconds). Default true.

window_days.description: Calendar days either side of the date for filings and news; default 2.

name: explain_move

outputSchema.description: move: returns, beta, abnormal return and z-score; filings and news rows in the order of their columns.

title: Explain a stock move
